text: Make a 4:5 flyer with only “Printmakers' Open Studio”, “9 October 2027”, “11:00–17:00”, and “Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB”—keep the full address letter for letter, including punctuation, wrapping lines if needed but never shortening it.
